message:
The device takes wind in and sends wake air out while passing shaft energy to electrics and trip signals to the brake, so the whiteboard holds the full chain as Capture wind energy, Hold rotor assembly, Generate electricity, Feed electrical load, Sense unsafe condition, and Brake rotor with energy, material and signal flows linking each hand-over.

Aero-Rotor Lead, Structures-Survival Engineer, Power-Systems Engineer and Safety-Control Integrator will each first post the best existing small wind turbine competition winners, products and papers from their field as concepts with sources, then each post for every function at least one concept from their field or state in one line that their field has none, and add any missing function they see.

Aero-Rotor Lead will use calc for shaft power between 5 m/s and 11 m/s, Structures-Survival Engineer will use calc for fit inside the 45 cm cube and for thrust and bending survival at 22 m/s, Power-Systems Engineer will use calc for electrical output and load-loss voltage, and Safety-Control Integrator will use simulate for rotor slow-down to below 10 % of top speed within 10 s and staying there, since stopping changes over time.

Not ready, because functions are set but no concepts or evidence have been posted yet.
